item.title: Synology Chat and Open Standards
item.author: technicalblog123@arran4.com (Arran Ubels)
item.description: I ended up setting my own Matrix server on my synology. However, it occurred to me that if Synology were to adopt open standards their provided apps, like Synology Chat would be substantially more useful. Especially since they have built out encryption in a similar way to how it works in Matrix, least at the surface level. Plus they would get a much larger user base. – Even if it was a couple specs behind it would be quite useful as it would effectively be a managed deploy for me.
